newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firmer with the market weighing the prospects of a breakout, although traders also looked to Bunds as a factor influencing direction.

One Swiss trader said curve-flattening trades were a main focus for customers, citing switching out of federal, or "Confederate" bonds maturing in 2000 and into bonds with maturities of 2003 or slightly longer.

Money market traders said meanwhile the Swiss National Bank added funds in the afternoon at 1-9/16 percent to November 18, and also added overnight funds at 2-1/8 percent. The action was seen as a routine move to offset month-end tightness.
The SNB said after Thursday's regular meeting that it left its discount rate steady at 1.00 percent, the level set since it lowered the rate from 1.50 percent on September 26.

The Dec Conf remained in a narrowing wedge with descending highs from 115.80 on October 9. The contract pushed to the day-session high in late trade of 114.85. The move above 114.80 resistance was seen as positive for the day.

The longer-term pattern may argue for a break-out. One technical analyst believed that currently a short-term oversold condition exists which argues for a break to the upside, with 116.00 as a possible target.

One Swiss trader also saw room for the Dec Conf to gain back to 115.60 to 115.80. But he cautioned that any move would likely be determined at least in part by German Bunds. The 10-year spread between Swiss and German cash bond yields has remained steady lately at around 210 basis points, where it ended the day Thursday YLDS3.
Markets are also waiting for release of U.S. nonfarm payroll data. October payrolls are forecast to rise by 212,000 jobs. The data are due at 1330 GMT.
European trade is apt to be thinned on Friday by the All Saint's Day holiday, with some European centres closed.
Dec Conf futures CONFZ6 up 18 at 114.85.
Dec Comi medium-term bond COMIZ6 up 45 at 110.60
Dec Euro Swiss francs FESZ6 down three at 98.12.
